label: Finding-49
title: rce-fpm: Glossary short text for PHP-FPM says 'whether a full exploit exists is disputed'
description: data/glossary.json (id fpm) short: 'Susceptible; whether a full exploit exists is disputed.' The PHP advisory GHSA-6wmf and oss-security 21/7 say FPM RCE was validated/demonstrated for CVE-2026-109619. The long text is accurate ('for the first flaw'); the short text misleads.
